formats.key: Permit(address owner,address spender,uint256 value,uint256 nonce,uint256 deadline)
effects: Once anyone submits the signature to permit(), the PNG allowance of owner to spender is set to value. That overwrites any earlier allowance and does not add to it.
If value is exactly uint256 max, the allowance is uint96 max: unlimited, and transferFrom never reduces it. Any other value above 2^96 reverts.
The owner's permit nonce goes up by one. This uses up the signature and cancels any other signature that uses the same nonce.
The signature cannot be used after the deadline timestamp.
No tokens move when the permit is used. The spender can later move up to value PNG from owner with transferFrom.
formats.shown: The intent "Authorize spending of tokens" is shown with the spender address (raw), the max PNG amount ("Unlimited" at 2^255 or above), the expiry date and the owner. The nonce is hidden.

findings.title: Permit has no interpolatedIntent, so the intent line names neither the spender nor the amount.
findings.evidence: descriptor.json display.formats Permit: "intent": "Authorize spending of tokens" with no interpolatedIntent. Png.sol permit(): allowances[owner][spender] = amount; the spender and value fields are both always visible and can go in the sentence.
findings.fix: Add "interpolatedIntent": "Allow {spender} to spend up to {value} until {deadline}".
